---
# Honors Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: honors-setup
#| include: false

# Process honors data if it exists
if (!exists("honors") || is.null(honors) || nrow(honors) == 0) {
  # Create empty dataframe with expected structure
  honors <- data.frame(
    honor_name = character(),
    granting_org = character(), 
    year = integer(),
    location = character(),
    description = character(),
    highlight = logical(),
    display_order = integer()
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: honors-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

if (exists("honors") && !is.null(honors) && nrow(honors) > 0) {
  cat('## Honors & Awards\n\n')
  
  honors_display <- honors %>%
    arrange(desc(year))
  
  if (nrow(honors_display) > 0) {
    cat('<div class="honors-section">\n')
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(honors_display)) {
      # Extract values using YOUR column names
      year_val <- if(!is.na(honors_display$year[i])) as.character(honors_display$year[i]) else ""
      honor_name <- if(!is.na(honors_display$honor_grant[i])) honors_display$honor_grant[i] else ""
      granting_org <- if(!is.na(honors_display$grantor[i])) honors_display$grantor[i] else ""
      location_val <- if("where" %in% names(honors_display) && !is.na(honors_display$where[i])) honors_display$where[i] else ""
      detail_val <- if("detail" %in% names(honors_display) && !is.na(honors_display$detail[i])) honors_display$detail[i] else ""
      
      if (honor_name != "" || granting_org != "") {
        cat(paste0('
<div class="honor-item">
<div class="honor-year">', year_val, '</div>
<div class="honor-content">
<div class="honor-title">', honor_name, '</div>
<div class="honor-org">', granting_org, '</div>'))
        
        # Add location if available
        if (location_val != "") {
          cat(paste0('<div class="honor-location">', location_val, '</div>'))
        }
        
        # Add detail if available
        if (detail_val != "") {
          cat(paste0('<div class="honor-description">', detail_val, '</div>'))
        }
        
        cat('
</div>
</div>
'))
      }
    }
    
    cat('</div>\n')
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: honors-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

if (exists("honors") && !is.null(honors) && nrow(honors) > 0) {
  # Don't print section title here - it's handled in the main document
  honors_display <- honors %>%
    arrange(desc(year))
  
  if (nrow(honors_display) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(honors_display)) {
      # Extract values using YOUR column names
      year_val <- if(!is.na(honors_display$year[i])) {
        as.character(honors_display$year[i])
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      honor_name <- if(!is.na(honors_display$honor_grant[i])) {
        as.character(honors_display$honor_grant[i])
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      granting_org <- if(!is.na(honors_display$grantor[i])) {
        as.character(honors_display$grantor[i])
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      location_val <- if("where" %in% names(honors_display) && 
                        !is.na(honors_display$where[i]) && 
                        honors_display$where[i] != "") {
        as.character(honors_display$where[i])
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      detail_val <- if("detail" %in% names(honors_display) && 
                      !is.na(honors_display$detail[i]) && 
                      honors_display$detail[i] != "") {
        as.character(honors_display$detail[i])
      } else {
        ""
      }
      
      # Output the honor
      if (honor_name != "" || granting_org != "") {
        # Honor name and year
        cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(honor_name), "}", sep = "")
        if (location_val != "") {
          cat(" -- ", escape_latex(location_val), sep = "")
        }
        cat("\n\n")
        
        # Granting organization
        if (granting_org != "") {
          cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(granting_org), "}", sep = "")
          if (year_val != "") {
            cat(", ", year_val, sep = "")
          }
          cat("\n\n")
        }
        
        # Detail if available
        if (detail_val != "") {
          cat(escape_latex(detail_val), "\n\n")
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
